question: Koraput, Rayagada, Kalahandi, Balangir districts of Odisha are famous for which mining mineral?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bauxite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The districts of **Koraput, Rayagada, Kalahandi, and Balangir** in Odisha are famous for **bauxite mining**.
 
• Bauxite is the principal ore of aluminum and is used in the production of various aluminum products.
 
• These districts have rich bauxite deposits, which are extensively mined and contribute significantly to Odisha's economy.
 
• The mining activities in these regions have also led to the development of related industries and employment opportunities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Odisha is one of the leading states in India in terms of bauxite production.
 
• Bauxite mining in Odisha is regulated by various state and central government agencies to ensure sustainable mining practices.
 
• The mined bauxite is processed in nearby aluminum plants to produce alumina and aluminum.
 
• Efforts are being made to balance the economic benefits of bauxite mining with environmental conservation and the well-being of local communities.
